title: TAP Studio video job
description: One video for the TAP Studio Agent to make. The payload of the Trigger.dev task `generate-video`.

job_id.description: Your id for the job. Echoed in every webhook and in the result.

format.description: motion_vsl: a voiced motion-graphics video made entirely with the renderer. reaction_showcase: an AI reaction clip (ugc-image-1 + seedance-2.5) followed by motion graphics. song_ad: a VidLab song-ad video with renderer captions and end card.

product.description: What the video is about. The agent states only what is given here.

price.description: The price as it should appear, for example "$5". The only amount the video may show.

cta.description: Button text on the end card, for example "GET STARTED –".

facts.description: True statements the video may use (what is included, numbers, who it is for).

image_urls.description: Product images for the AI models to use as references.

brief.description: Angle, audience, tone, anything the video must or must not do.

script.description: Optional. A script to use word for word (motion_vsl: the voiceover; song_ad: the lyrics).

duration_s.description: Target length in seconds. Default: 30 for motion_vsl, 20 for reaction_showcase, the song's own length for song_ad.

music.description: Put the bundled music bed under the voice (not used for song_ad).

compliance.description: meta_safe applies the Meta ad rules (no earnings claims, no amounts except the price, no money visuals).

max_usd.description: Hard cap on what VidLab generations may cost for this job. A paid call that would pass it is refused.

max_agent_usd.description: Cap on the agent's own model usage (Anthropic API).

upload_url.description: Where the MP4 is sent with an HTTP PUT. A Bunny Storage URL (https://storage.bunnycdn.com/<zone>/<path>.mp4) or any pre-signed URL.

upload_headers.description: Extra upload headers. For Bunny Storage, AccessKey is added from BUNNY_STORAGE_API_KEY when it is not given here.

public_url.description: The URL the video is readable at after upload (your Bunny pull zone). Reported as video_url.

webhooks.description: Both are POSTed JSON, signed with HMAC-SHA256 (headers X-Tap-Timestamp and X-Tap-Signature: sha256=<hex of timestamp + "." + body>).

secret.description: HMAC secret for this job. Default: the WEBHOOK_HMAC_SECRET environment variable.

metadata.description: Anything; echoed back in the result.
